title: Coast Guard, partner agencies hold search and rescue survivor reunion
description: Coast Guard crews from Air Station Clearwater, Station Mayport, the cutter Coho, and partner agencies held a search and rescue survivor reunion with Charles Gregory, Sept. 21, 2023, St. Augustine, Florida. The family honored the men and women who rescued their son 12 miles offshore of St. Augustine, Aug. 5, 2023.
